observations.observation: Settings is a plain class with class-level configuration defaults. __init__ does not load environment variables. These are observed defaults, not an approved deployment profile.

Standalone FastAPI app declares health/readiness, status/dashboard/positions/signals/orders/calendar/performance GET routes and pause/resume POST routes. These are observed declarations; endpoint execution was not tested.
Imports .aggregator.DataAggregator and .health.HealthChecker. Neither helper module exists in the current services/gui-gateway/src tree. Keep startup conformance unresolved.

Defines response models ServiceHealth, SystemMetrics, SystemStatus, PositionSummary, SignalFeed, OrderHistory, CalendarEvent, TradingStatistics, MarketData, TradingDashboard, EmergencyControl and PerformanceMetrics. These local implementation models do not establish the B1/B2 wire contract.

GUIGatewayPlugin separately declares GET /status, /plugins and /health. Starts a uvicorn server with configured http_port default 8080; shutdown waits up to 5 seconds. Its docstring mentions WebSocket but no WebSocket route is declared. Entrypoint selection remains unresolved.
